title: Spring Festival Fair
audience: Chinese senior high school students (16-18 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A busy Spring Festival fair street: a red banner, red lanterns, a golden dragon dance, a food stall with a price board and a red riddle board
imageDescription: A busy Spring Festival fair on a winter day in China. Across the top hangs a long red banner reading SPRING FESTIVAL FAIR. Below it, many round red lanterns with gold tassels hang on strings across the street. On the left is a food stall with a red awning. On its counter sit a round bamboo steamer with hot white dumplings and a glass jar of candied hawthorn sticks. A white price board reads DUMPLINGS 5 YUAN and TANGHULU 3 YUAN. In front of the stall a girl in a red winter coat eats a candied hawthorn stick with her eyes closed and a big smile. Behind her, students and a foreign teacher with glasses in a blue sweater clap and watch. In the center, three performers in red and gold costumes perform a golden dragon dance with poles, the dragon raised high above their heads. On the right stands a large red riddle board on wooden legs reading RIDDLE: I AM WHITE FOOD. I AM HOT. WHAT AM I? In the background there is a red festival gate with doors decorated with red banners with gold trim, bare winter trees, patches of snow and falling confetti.
scoringDescription: A busy Spring Festival fair on a street in China on a clear winter day. At the top a long red banner reads SPRING FESTIVAL FAIR. Many round red lanterns with gold tassels hang on strings above the street. In the center, three performers in red and gold traditional costumes perform a golden dragon dance, holding the long golden dragon high on poles; the dragon's mouth is open and its body curves. Around them people clap and smile: a foreign teacher with glasses in a blue sweater claps with both hands, and several Chinese students, including a girl in pink and a girl in yellow, watch happily; two small boys clap near them. On the left a food stall has a red awning; on the counter are a round bamboo steamer with hot white dumplings, steam rising from it, and a glass jar of candied hawthorn sticks. A white price board reads DUMPLINGS 5 YUAN per basket and TANGHULU 3 YUAN per stick, so one basket of dumplings plus one tanghulu costs 8 yuan. A girl in a red winter coat with white boots eats a tanghulu with her eyes closed and a big smile, so she clearly enjoys it. On the right a large red riddle board on wooden legs reads RIDDLE: I AM WHITE FOOD. I AM HOT. WHAT AM I? The answer is the dumplings in the steamer. Winter evidence: bare trees without leaves, white snow on the ground and on the walls, and everyone wears warm winter coats and boots. In the background a red festival gate has doors decorated with red banners with gold trim; colorful confetti falls and the sky is light blue.
